blocks.tamil_translation: not have,” he said. “Go to such-and-such a person! He had made preparations for Jihad. Now he has fallen ill. (He sent word: tell him that Rasulullah ﷺ has sent you his Salam. And tell him to give you the things he had prepared for Jihad.)” Accordingly, that young man went to that Ansari Sahabi and said, “Rasulullah ﷺ has sent you his Salam. And he told you to give me the things you had kept ready for Jihad.” He said (to his wife), “O so-and-so! Give this man the things I had prepared. Do not keep back any item from them. I swear by Allah Ta'ala! Whatever you keep back from it, there will be no barakah for you in it.” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ حَبَسَ فَرَساً فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ كَانَ سِتْرَهُ مِنْ نَارٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه عبد بن حميد، المسند الجامع:٥ /٥٤٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Zaid ibn Thabit (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “Whoever makes waqf of a horse in the path of Allah Ta'ala, this act of his will become a screen for him from the fire of Jahannam.”

blocks.text: 3. Etiquette of Going Out in the Path of Allah and the Deeds to Do in It

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (اِذْهَبْ أَنْتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِايتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فيِ ذِكْرِي ۞ اِذْهَبَآ
